verdict.rationale: Together AI documents a public REST API callable from any language, with official Python and TypeScript SDKs. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec (openapi.yaml, listed in llms.txt), generated per-endpoint reference pages, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and a model deprecation policy. The API covers inference, batch, fine-tuning and dedicated endpoints; the OpenAPI probe 404s were only on .json paths, and the YAML spec exists. Missing for 10: substantive independent hands-on corroboration beyond a single community mention of the Python API.
